label: ქრონიკა
about: The Chronicler: life before and after, told in one continuous move through time.
brief: The film moves through time: each scene is one dated beat, in order.
First 2 s: the hook says what changes and when.
Then the beats in time order: when it starts, what happens, when it ends or what follows.
Use exact dates and times from the articles; never a relative day.
Before and after values (change, trend) only when the articles state them.
The viewer leaves knowing the order of events and the dates that matter.
pacing: one scene per dated beat, even in length.
